unit: one L2 design with one prespecified primary outcome
denominator: all admitted registry designs, retaining stopped, unestimated and missing records
confirmatory_population: designs whose outcomes were unexposed when the signed final preregistration was frozen

inference.read_at: Close enrollment at 100 distinct admitted designs or freeze+6 months, whichever first; close analysis after each reaches processing age60 (month8 latest). No stopped/unavailable replacements.
inference.milestone_50: metadata, denominator and coverage review only; no outcome association read
inference.dependence: Q1 joint calibrated null replays; Q2/Q4 family bootstrap plus shared state/calendar influence-score covariance; Q3 one centered studentized joint family/state/outcome/calendar block replay of estimators and scores, with forecasts fixed; Q5 wave-adjusted family wild null score. All require pre-outcome synthetic size validation.
inference.insufficient_support: report registered question as unresolved; no extension chosen by significance

questions.name: Observed noise-exceedance rate
questions.primary: share whose absolute frozen estimate exceeds its own prespecified 95% null-reference absolute threshold
questions.test: one-sided rate above calibrated null tail; joint null replays preserve cross-design dependence; independent exact binomial is a planning benchmark only
questions.missing: retain all designs in registry denominator; estimate rate among eligible plus all-design sharp missing-outcome bounds
questions.secondary: latent effect normal sampling-error mixture on theta/noiseSD with grid -10..10 by .1 plus zero; nonnegative likelihood weights; grid +/-20 sensitivity; valid sampling variance and joint covariance required; failure is NOT_IDENTIFIED

questions.name: Aligned literature replication gap
questions.primary: mean a_i*(b_literature_i-b_i)/s_pre_i; benchmark direction and clean-preperiod outcome SD fixed before our result
questions.test: two-sided mean paired-gap test with common covariance/family-block procedure
questions.missing: all registry designs retained; unmatched/estimand-incompatible cases do not become zero gaps
questions.interpretation: a replication gap does not identify publication bias without additional selection assumptions

questions.name: Locked forecast Brier skill
questions.primary: mean over designs of [.25 - mean over five fixed internal forecast slots of (p_positive - 1{b>0})^2]; mean slot loss, not Brier loss of the averaged probability
questions.test: H0 mean design score difference=0; centered studentized joint block bootstrap replays frozen estimator panels once per draw with fixed forecasts, 99% null criticals; no second score measurement-error correction; invalid calibrated size means descriptive only
questions.target: realized frozen estimator positivity b>0, not unobserved causal truth
questions.semantics: future primary requires five explicit P(b>0) forecasts locked before anchor/calibration/outcome access; historical exclusive noise-category ledgers remain descriptive and cannot be pooled
questions.secondary: direction accuracy, 80% predictive coverage, calibration bins/intercept/slope, signed forecast-direction overstatement, diagnostic-event Brier separately
required_future_ledger_fields: joint diagnostic-pass probability conditional on technical readiness

questions.name: Adoption and effect strength
questions.primary: beta_A in equal-design T_i=alpha_domain+beta_A*A_i+gamma*H_i+error, T_i=(b_i^2-v_i)/s_pre_i^2; retain negative T
questions.test: two-sided beta_A with common covariance/blocks, conditional on frozen measured adoption index; residual A variation after domain/horizon controls required
questions.sampling_variance: E[b|theta]=theta; v consistently estimates Var(b|theta); a certified interval, placebo SD or RI p alone is insufficient
questions.secondary: early/latest adoption thirds, same supported e=0..2 horizon and weights; requires prespecified L2 cohort contrast; overall ATT insufficient; separately frozen adoption-index measurement-error sensitivity
questions.partisan_index: absolute difference in Democratic-/Republican-unified-government first-adoption hazards using independently verified Jan-1 party and at-risk state-years; >=20 risk-years/group; standardized from metadata only

questions.name: Evaluability across six domains
questions.primary: six-domain technically-estimable status by fixed processing age60; unresolved/stopped/unestimated remain in denominator
questions.test: H0 E[estimable|domain,wave]=p_wave; wave-only null fitted, five domain score components aggregated by family; quadratic omnibus with 9999 mean-zero family wild multipliers; require20 independent families,5 designs/domain,full residual rank and artificial-null size validation
questions.denominator: design-level primary denominator includes stopped/unestimated; separate L1 text-to-policy-to-design denominators with versioned deduplication
questions.scope: project-reportable means fixed support/integrity/diagnostic requirements; sign, significance and journal acceptance excluded

execution_gate: signed final preregistration, roster and timestamp hashes
frozen outcome mappings, noise thresholds and probability semantics
verified literature match and adoption covariate specifications
read-only outcome adapter separately implemented and reviewed
>=20 eligible families for every question; >=5 designs/domain and full residual rank for Q5; invalid shared-shock/size checks report unavailable without independent-test substitution
enrollment: Freeze domain/tie/selection rules now; lock each new design/outcome/spec/forecast before any anchor/calibration/estimation. Fixed domain allocation: labor24, finance16, health14, crime9, education8, environment8. Overlap domains within later monthly waves.
